title: test user login endpoint
description: Verify that the /login endpoint successfully authenticates users with valid credentials and returns a 200 status code, and returns a 401 status code for invalid credentials.

title: test user registration endpoint
description: Verify that the /register endpoint allows new users to register with valid data including name, email, password, and password confirmation, and returns appropriate success or error responses.

title: test get all patients endpoint
description: Verify that the /hms/patients GET endpoint returns a list of patients with a 200 status code and the response contains expected patient data.

title: test create new patient endpoint
description: Verify that the /hms/patients POST endpoint creates a new patient when provided with valid patient details such as first name, last name, email, phone, date of birth, gender, and address, and returns a success response.

title: test get all doctors endpoint
description: Verify that the /hms/doctors GET endpoint returns a list of doctors with a 200 status code and the response contains expected doctor data.

title: test create new doctor endpoint
description: Verify that the /hms/doctors POST endpoint creates a new doctor profile with valid details including first name, last name, email, phone, department id, and specialization, and returns a success response.

title: test get all appointments endpoint
description: Verify that the /hms/appointments GET endpoint returns a list of appointments with a 200 status code and the response contains expected appointment data.

title: test create new appointment endpoint
description: Verify that the /hms/appointments POST endpoint creates a new appointment with valid patient id, doctor id, appointment date, appointment time, and reason, and returns a success response.

title: test get all invoices endpoint
description: Verify that the /hms/invoices GET endpoint returns a list of invoices with a 200 status code and the response contains expected invoice data.

title: test create new invoice endpoint
description: Verify that the /hms/invoices POST endpoint creates a new invoice with valid patient id, total amount, and items, and returns a success response.
